notes: Do not silently run driver cleaners, privacy tools, uninstallers, firmware tools, benchmark tools, or driver installers.
Do not bypass or remove licenses from third-party software.
Where licensing is undesirable, build a native replacement module instead of cloning or bypassing the commercial tool.
Keep benchmark tooling separate from the main app UI, but allow internal benchmark-provider integration after explicit user approval.

tools.name: Process Lasso
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Native process controls must capture original process state before apply.
tools.integrationPlan: Do not require or launch this utility for resident backend operation. Build native scheduler controls for priorities, affinities, I/O priority, and per-game rules.
tools.notes: Do not bypass licensing. Resident governor validation must pass without this utility installed or running.

tools.name: HWiNFO
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Not required for read-only sensor detection.
tools.integrationPlan: Create a separate monitoring section for CPU/GPU/RAM sensors, temperatures, clocks, power, utilization, and logging. Prefer reading HWiNFO shared memory or exported sensors when available.

tools.name: CPU-Z
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Not required for manual diagnostics.
tools.integrationPlan: Expose as a manual launcher and optionally parse exported reports for RAM type, slots, CPU model, motherboard, and BIOS.

tools.name: GPU-Z
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Not required for manual diagnostics.
tools.integrationPlan: Keep as optional manual GPU diagnostics if needed for VRAM, PCIe, driver, and sensor checks.

tools.name: MSI Afterburner
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Export current profiles and define rollback before any profile automation.
tools.integrationPlan: Expose install/launch/profile management. Startup is allowed only after user configures and approves GPU profiles. Do not auto-overclock by default.

tools.name: Display Driver Uninstaller
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point, capture current driver inventory, and require explicit safe-mode/user confirmation.
tools.integrationPlan: Offer a guided driver-clean workflow with restore point, network pause option, safe-mode instructions, and post-clean driver install selection. Never run silently.

tools.name: NVCleanstall
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point and capture current NVIDIA driver inventory before use.
tools.integrationPlan: Use for NVIDIA-only client workflows. Gate by hardware detection. Pair with tested driver recommendations and game tags.

tools.name: NVIDIA Profile Inspector
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Export current NVIDIA profile before import/apply.
tools.integrationPlan: Provide metadata-only NIP cataloging, manual import/export guidance, benchmark comparison, and top-five tested profile recommendations. Gate by NVIDIA GPU detection. Never launch NVPI or import .nip files from backend validation.

tools.name: O&O ShutUp10++
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Export privacy-related registry/policy state before any native apply.
tools.integrationPlan: Use as a reference/manual launcher. Native app should implement only the safe privacy subset with rollback and protected ecosystem rules.

tools.name: WPD
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Export privacy-related registry/policy state before any native apply.
tools.integrationPlan: Use as a reference/manual launcher. Native app should implement validated privacy toggles rather than blindly applying WPD presets.

tools.name: Native Bulk Uninstaller
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Native cleanup must export uninstall metadata, registry state, and deletion manifest before apply.
tools.integrationPlan: Build an in-app bulk uninstaller that enumerates MSI, uninstall registry entries, winget packages, Appx packages, services, tasks, startup entries, leftover files, and orphaned registry keys. Do not clone or bypass Revo licensing.

tools.name: Device Cleanup
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Export before/after PnP inventory before any native cleanup.
tools.integrationPlan: Build a dead-device cleanup module using Windows PnP inventory. Default to preview list, backup/export, then cleanup only disconnected/non-present devices.

tools.name: UserDiag
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Not required for manual diagnostic launch; native diagnostics should keep report artifacts user-visible.
tools.integrationPlan: Keep as separate diagnostic section.

tools.name: Autoruns
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Export startup/service/task state before any future removal workflow.
tools.integrationPlan: Educate and optionally expose as an advanced manual tool. Native app should implement safer startup inventory first.
tools.explanation: Autoruns shows nearly everything configured to launch automatically: Run keys, services, drivers, scheduled tasks, shell extensions, browser helpers, codecs, AppInit DLLs, and more. It is powerful but easy to overdo.

tools.name: Thorium
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Not applicable because this browser installer is excluded from default workflow.
tools.integrationPlan: Do not include in default workflow.

tools.name: Vesktop
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Not applicable because this installer is excluded from default workflow.
tools.integrationPlan: Do not include in default workflow.

tools.name: AffTool intPolicy
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Future apply would require exported interrupt policy state first.
tools.integrationPlan: Interrupt/affinity policy research/status first; no blind apply of bundled intPolicy binaries.

tools.name: MSI Utility v3
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Export device and registry MSI mode state before any future apply.
tools.integrationPlan: Read-only MSI mode/status detector first. Apply only later with restore/export proof.

tools.name: InSpectre
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Registry export and restore point required before any manual Spectre/Meltdown mitigation changes.
tools.integrationPlan: Security mitigation detector first; disabling Spectre/Meltdown mitigations is high-risk/manual-only and never silent.

tools.name: UnparkCPU
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Export active power plan before any native parking change.
tools.integrationPlan: Prefer native power-plan/core-parking controls; bundled tool stays manual/reference only unless a reversible native executor exists.

tools.name: LatencyMon
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Not required for diagnostics workflow.
tools.integrationPlan: Diagnostics workflow for DPC/ISR latency evidence, not an optimizer action.

tools.name: MSI Kombustor
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Confirm thermals, power, and user consent before any separate benchmark workflow.
tools.integrationPlan: Optional stress/benchmark tool, separate from the main optimizer and never auto-run.

tools.name: DL_SCEWIN
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Exact firmware setting export and rollback plan required before any manual use.
tools.integrationPlan: Firmware configuration utility is dangerous manual-only and must not become an optimizer action.

tools.name: AMD Graphics Driver Package 26.2.2
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point, capture current GPU driver, and provide rollback instructions before install.
tools.integrationPlan: Recommend only on AMD GPU systems. Manual confirmation required.

tools.name: AMD Chipset Driver Package 8.02.18.557
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point and capture installed driver inventory before install.
tools.integrationPlan: Recommend only when AMD platform hardware is detected. Manual confirmation required.

tools.name: Intel Chipset Driver Package
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point and capture installed driver inventory before install.
tools.integrationPlan: Recommend only when Intel platform hardware is detected. Manual confirmation required.

tools.name: NVIDIA 595.79 Driver Package (No NVIDIA App)
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point, capture current GPU driver, and provide rollback instructions before install.
tools.integrationPlan: Recommend only on NVIDIA GPU systems. Manual confirmation required.

tools.name: NVIDIA 595.79 Driver Package (With NVIDIA App)
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point, capture current GPU driver, and provide rollback instructions before install.
tools.integrationPlan: Recommend only on NVIDIA GPU systems. Manual confirmation required.

tools.name: Intel Network Driver Package
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point and capture current network adapter driver inventory before install.
tools.integrationPlan: Recommend only for matching Intel network adapters. Manual confirmation required.

tools.name: Realtek Network Driver Package
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point and capture current network adapter driver inventory before install.
tools.integrationPlan: Recommend only for matching Realtek network adapters. Manual confirmation required.

tools.name: Intel PROSet SetupBD
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point and capture current network adapter driver inventory before install.
tools.integrationPlan: Catalog as the Intel network package setup helper. It stays hardware-gated and manually confirmed.

tools.name: Intel PROSet PROUnstl Helpers
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point and export network adapter driver state before any manual use.
tools.integrationPlan: Catalog only as bundled helper executables. Do not expose as default cleanup or optimization actions.

tools.name: Driver Booster
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Not applicable because this updater is excluded from default integration.
tools.integrationPlan: Excluded from default driver strategy. Prefer hardware-gated recommendations and manual driver packages.

tools.name: .NET Framework 3.5 Prerequisite
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point before dependency repair/install.
tools.integrationPlan: Dependency repair/install workflow only, explicit confirmation required.

tools.name: DirectX Runtime Prerequisite
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point before dependency repair/install.
tools.integrationPlan: Dependency repair/install workflow only, explicit confirmation required.

tools.name: Visual C++ Redistributable Prerequisites
tools.restoreBackupRequirement: Create restore point before dependency repair/install.
tools.integrationPlan: Dependency repair/install workflow only, explicit confirmation required.

driverStrategy.description: Driver installers are shown only when matching hardware is detected. The app should also detect installed games and show driver recommendations tagged by tested game logos.
driverStrategy.metadataUpdate: allow app-side driver/game metadata updates without rebuilding the app

benchmarkStrategy.description: The app should orchestrate benchmarking internally when needed, but benchmark setup/results should remain in a separate workflow rather than cluttering the main optimizer dashboard.
